name: Medallion Payer Enrollment
description: Medallion Payer Enrollment automates the insurance credentialing and payer enrollment process for healthcare providers. The service handles application submissions, status tracking, and follow-up with insurance companies, helping mental health practices get credentialed faster with commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid payers.
short_description: Automated payer enrollment service handling insurance credentialing applications and follow-up for mental health practices.
one_liner: Insurance credentialing automation for mental health providers

pricing.notes: Payer enrollment typically costs $200-500 per enrollment. Volume discounts available.

best_for: Providers seeking to join multiple payer networks
Digital health companies scaling provider enrollment
Practices expanding to new insurance panels
not_ideal_for: Providers already credentialed with all desired payers

faqs.q: How long does Medallion payer enrollment take?
faqs.a: Medallion typically completes payer enrollment in 30-90 days depending on the insurance company.

faqs.a: Medallion payer enrollment typically costs $200-500 per enrollment with volume discounts.
